pro_course_detail.title: Speaking Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
These are classes for students who want to improve their speaking and listening skills, to develop fluency and confidence while increasing vocabulary by acquiring useful words and phrases in use. 
This is a non-textbook based language course, however, if there are grammar areas you find out you'd like to improve, we may consider including bite-sized grammar topics in each lesson. You are advised to: 
1) Pick a topic that interests you beforehand. It can either be a specific subject or just a more general one, such as travel, food and drink, hobbies and sports, home and garden, pets and animals and many others. 
2) Receive a video link, a list of questions or an article on the topic before a lesson.
3) Get ready to discuss the material in class. It usually requires students to retell the source, to think about their personal attitude toward the topic and to be prepared to answer the teacher's questions and to hold a discussion, applying the new vocabulary you faced in the source.
While we talk, I will write down the most common mistakes you make in pronunciation, grammar, and word choice. At the end of the lesson I will send you the list of mistakes and we will correct them together. If needed, I will teach you the grammar rule or the proper pronunciation, and will ask you to work on examples until you are comfortable with the rule.

pro_course_detail.title: Let's speak Russian! Conversation class

pro_course_detail.title: Let's speak English! Conversation class
pro_course_detail.description:
I completely understand that even if you're not a beginner, speaking English can still feel intimidating. But don't worry, I'm here to help you overcome that fear and discomfort through our conversation class.
In our class, we can discuss a wide range of topics based on your interests and preferences. Whether it's art, science, movies, travel, life, space, hobbies, books, goals, dreams, work, or anything else you'd like to talk about, the choice is yours! The main goal is to provide you with a relaxed and enjoyable environment where you can freely express yourself in English.
During our conversation practice, I won't rely on specific learning materials. Instead, the focus will be on having meaningful discussions that engage you. By doing so, you'll naturally enhance your language skills, gain fluency, and build confidence. Rest assured that if there are any pronunciation or grammar mistakes, I'll kindly correct them and provide constructive feedback. The key is to have fun while learning!

В ходе наших бесед я буду исправлять ваши ошибки и давать обратную связь. Моя задача - помочь вам улучшить ваше произношение, грамматику и словарный запас. Я создам комфортную и поддерживающую атмосферу, где вы сможете расслабиться и постепенно преодолеть языковой барьер.
